description: A33: the body of POST /auth/register as the app sends it. terms_version and privacy_version are the front-matter versions of docs/legal/terms.md and privacy.md the user accepted (YYYY-MM-DD, real dates). The server stores them with legal_accepted_at from its own clock and never returns them.
rules: terms_version and privacy_version are required; each is YYYY-MM-DD and a real calendar date, otherwise 422 validation_failed naming the field
users.terms_version, users.privacy_version and users.legal_accepted_at (server clock) are stored; none of them appears in /me or the sync user entity
